_readme: One record per claim that needs vendor evidence (CR-01, CR-07).
The measured conditions are mandatory. A value measured at 23 °C does not license
a claim about a freezer, and a value measured on flat aluminium does not license a
claim about a textured painted surface. Copying the number without its conditions
is how an evidenced claim becomes a false one.

product._note: Must be a product ACS actually sells. Needs SRC-02, the ACS product list.

measured_conditions._note: Leave a field empty only if the datasheet itself does not state it — and then the claim must not imply it.
